description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Navigate to the public channel #release-updates (preloaded with real release announcements from the official Rocket.Chat GitHub releases feed). Find the message announcing release 7.10.7 (published 2026-01-13) and star it. Starring a message saves it to your personal starred messages list for quick reference later.
